Mia: quick Q — saw a canary where a request with modelId=\"redwood/gpt-6\" + region=\"eu-central\" + routeTier=\"standard\" hit a quantized fallback (redwood/gpt-6-q) even though the client sent an explicit pin header. Should a pin always override region/tier mismatches?

Dan: pins are supposed to be strong, but they can be ignored if the pinned variant is incompatible/unavailable. can you paste the request headers + selector logs? pinging @Shruti for selector rules.

Mia: pasted logs below — note the header X-Model-Pin: redwood/gpt-6 and X-Routing-Hints: region=eu-central;tier=standard

```
Request headers:
  X-Model-Pin: redwood/gpt-6
  X-Routing-Hints: region=eu-central;tier=standard
Selector trace:
  evaluate_availability -> fail(region_avail=false for redwood/gpt-6@eu-central)
  check_pin -> present
  check_compatibility -> redwood/gpt-6-q compat=false
  choose_fallback -> redwood/gpt-6-q
  served_model: redwood/gpt-6-q
```

Shruti: digging in — selector logic is: 1) filter by region availability, 2) try to honor pin if pinned variant is in filtered set, 3) otherwise pick highest-priority compatible fallback. The subtlety: we treat availability filter as a hard pre-filter to avoid routing across regions; that means a pin for a model not present in region doesn't survive unless we relax region routing. In this trace the exact pinned model wasn't available in eu-central, so it fell out before pin check. The compat=false on the quantized variant then prevented the pinned binary from being used.

Ben: ok — two things: 1) this behavior is surprising given docs that say \"pins override routing hints\"; we should clarify the API contract (pins override only when availability check passes). 2) can we add a diagnostic in the response (ServedModelReason) saying \"pin_unavailable_region\" or \"pin_incompatibility\" so clients know?

Mia: yes that would help clients handle graceful fallback. Also asking for a short API doc blurb we can link in the error message.

Dan: agree with Ben. i'll open a tiny PR to surface fallback reason in the ServedModel object and add a non-breaking contract note. will try to review today. @Shruti can you confirm compat flag semantics so we word this precisely?

Shruti: compat is set at model-variant onboarding. true means binary-interface compatible for direct swap; false means may change output tokens / kv cache layout so we avoid transparent swaps. i'll add a sentence in the model onboarding doc and drop a quick note in the API contract PR.

Mia: PR ping: #5234 — updates selector to attach served_model_reason and includes unit test for region prefilter. @Dan PTAL when you have a minute. :pray:

Dan: will review this afternoon, small nits possible but 👍 overall. also suggest telemetry tag fallback_reason for rollout metrics.

deploy-bot: canary deployed selector v2.14 -> staging (2023-08-31T14:22:00Z) :rocket:

Mia: thanks all — moving this to async docs queue. I'll follow up with the doc links and the client-side guidance (how to detect pin fallthrough and opt into cross-region pinning if needed). :+1:
